responses.title: New lead - no details yet
responses.text:
Hi [Name]! This is [Your name] with [Company].

Happy to help! What kind of cleaning are you looking for — a deep clean, regular upkeep, or move-in/move-out?

And what's your ZIP?

responses.title: Lead already sent all details
responses.text:
Hi [Name]! This is [Your name] with [Company].

Got it — a [deep clean] on a [4 bed / 3.5 bath] in [City] before you move in. That's exactly what we do.

responses.title: "What areas do you serve?"
responses.text:
Hi [Name]! This is [Your name] with [Company].

We cover [City] and the surrounding area. What's your ZIP? I'll confirm right away.

responses.title: Confirming we cover the area
responses.text: Perfect, we cover [City]!

responses.title: Outside service area
responses.text: Thanks for checking, [Name]! We're not covering [City] just yet, but we're expanding — want me to reach out when we do?

responses.title: Explain the free walkthrough
responses.text:
For the exact price we do a quick walkthrough of the home — completely free, about 15 minutes, and no commitment.

That way you get a real number instead of a guess.

Does [day] between [time] and [time] work for you?

responses.title: "How long is the walkthrough?"
responses.text:
Just 15 minutes — we look at the size and condition of the home and give you the exact price right there.

Does [day] at [time] work?

responses.title: No visit wanted - collect details
responses.text:
No problem at all, [Name]! We can do it without the visit.

I'll just need the size of the home, how many bedrooms and bathrooms, and how it's looking right now — light upkeep, or does it need a deeper clean?

I'll get you a price today.

responses.title: Video walkthrough - plan B
responses.text:
Totally understand, [Name]! If an in-person visit isn't convenient, we can also do a quick video walkthrough — you walk me through the home on a call and we give you the price right after.

Would that be easier?

responses.title: 1st time asking price - standard
responses.text:
Totally understand wanting a number up front!

Price depends on the size and condition of the home, so instead of guessing we do a free 15-minute walkthrough and give you the exact price on the spot. No commitment.

Does [day] between [time] and [time] work for you?

responses.title: Price ask - two slots to choose
responses.text:
Great question, [Name]! Every home is a little different, so we give exact prices after a free 15-minute walkthrough — that way you never overpay for a guess.

I have [Tuesday at 10:00 AM] or [Thursday at 4:30 PM] open. Which one is easier for you?

responses.title: Price ask - speed angle
responses.text:
I can get you an exact number as early as [day], [Name]! The walkthrough is free, takes just 15 minutes, and you get the price on the spot — no commitment.

Is morning or afternoon better for you?

responses.title: Price ask - fair pricing angle
responses.text:
We price by size and condition, so you only pay for what your home actually needs — nothing more.

The 15-minute walkthrough is free and you get the exact price right there. Want me to save [day] at [time] for you?

responses.title: Price ask - micro-question first
responses.text:
Happy to get you a price, [Name]! Quick question so I quote it right: are you thinking a one-time deep clean or regular upkeep?

Either way the 15-minute estimate is free — I have [day] at [time] open this week.

responses.title: Price ask - hold a spot
responses.text:
Totally fair to ask, [Name]! The exact number comes from a free 15-minute walkthrough — no commitment at all.

I have a couple of spots left this week. Want me to hold [day] at [time] for you while you decide?

responses.title: 2nd insistence - give a range
responses.text:
I hear you! For a [4 bed / 3.5 bath] deep clean in [City], it usually lands somewhere in the [$X–$Y] range, depending on the condition of the home.

The walkthrough is how we lock in the exact number — free, 15 minutes.

Would [day] at [time] work?

responses.title: Propose time - direct (default)
responses.text: Does [Wednesday] between [5:00] and [5:30 PM] work for you?

responses.title: Propose time - two options
responses.text: I have [Tuesday at 10:00 AM] or [Thursday at 4:30 PM] open. Which one is easier for you?

responses.title: Requested day is full
responses.text:
[Thursday] is fully booked this week — but I can do [Saturday at 12:00 PM], or first thing [Thursday] next week.

Which one works better for you?

responses.title: Need to check with the owner
responses.text: Perfect, [Name] — let me check our availability for [day] and I'll get right back to you with a time.

responses.title: Time accepted - get address & phone
responses.text:
Perfect, [Name]! You're all set for [day] at [time].

Could you confirm the full address and the best phone number?

responses.title: Final confirmation
responses.text:
Thank you, [Name]! We have your address and phone number.

See you [Wednesday] at [5:00 PM]!

responses.title: Direct hire - confirm details
responses.text:
Perfect, [Name]! Let me get you a price.

Just to confirm: [deep clean], [X] bedrooms, [X] bathrooms, around [X] sqft — anything else you'd like included?

responses.title: Coming back with the owner's price
responses.text:
Thanks for waiting, [Name]! For a [deep clean] at [X] bed / [X] bath, we're at [$X] — that includes everything, we bring all our own supplies.

I have [day] at [time] open. Want me to book it for you?

responses.title: "Are you licensed and insured?"
responses.text:
Yes — we're fully insured, and we bring all our own supplies and equipment.

Would [day] between [time] and [time] work for the walkthrough?

responses.title: "Do I need to provide anything?"
responses.text: Nope — we bring everything: products, vacuum, all of it. Nothing for you to provide.

responses.title: "What's included in a regular clean?"
responses.text:
A regular clean covers dusting, all bathrooms, kitchen surfaces and the outside of appliances, floors vacuumed and mopped, trash out, and general tidying.

If the home needs more than upkeep, we'd start with a deep clean first.

Which one sounds closer to what you need?

responses.title: "How long does the cleaning take?"
responses.text:
It depends on the size and condition of the home — most take a few hours. We'll give you an exact time at the walkthrough.

Does [day] at [time] work?

responses.title: "How many cleaners come?"
responses.text: Usually a team of 1–2, sometimes 3 for bigger homes.

responses.title: "I'm out of town this week"
responses.text:
No problem! We have plenty of availability next week.

Would [Tuesday between 4:30 and 5:00 PM] work for the walkthrough? Just say the word and I'll lock it in.

responses.title: "I just need it once, not regular"
responses.text:
That's totally fine — a lot of people start with a one-time deep clean and decide later.

The walkthrough is free either way. Does [day] at [time] work?

responses.title: "Let me think about it"
responses.text:
Of course, [Name]! The walkthrough is free and only takes 15 minutes, so there's nothing to commit to.

I still have [day] at [time] open — want me to hold it for you?

responses.title: Follow-up 1 - same day
responses.text: Hi [Name]! Just checking back — does [day] between [time] and [time] still work for the walkthrough?

responses.title: Follow-up 2 - next morning (best one)
responses.text:
Good morning, [Name]! Still happy to get you on the schedule.

I have [day] at [time] open — want me to lock it in for you?

responses.title: Follow-up 3 - day 3 with scarcity
responses.text:
Hi [Name]! We're filling up the schedule for this week and I have a couple of spots left for the free walkthrough.

Want me to save one for you?

responses.title: Follow-up 4 - day 5 last call
responses.text:
Hi [Name]! I'll stop here so I'm not filling up your inbox 🙂

If you'd still like that free estimate, just send me a message and I'll get you scheduled the same week.

responses.title: Reengage with a time in hand
responses.text:
Hi [Name]! Just got our schedule for [this/next week] — I have [day] at [time] open for the free walkthrough.

Want me to save it for you?

responses.title: Reengage - answer their question first
responses.text:
Hi [Name]! Coming back to you on this.

[direct answer to what they asked]

Does [day] at [time] work for the walkthrough?

responses.title: Day before the visit
responses.text: Hi [Name]! Just confirming your free estimate tomorrow at [time]. See you then!

responses.title: Day of the visit
responses.text: Hi [Name]! We'll see you today at [time]. Let me know if anything changes.

responses.title: They need to reschedule
responses.text: No problem at all! I have [day] at [time] or [day] at [time]. Which one is better?

responses.title: They declined - polite close
responses.text: No problem at all, [Name] — thanks for letting me know! If anything changes, I'm right here.

responses.title: Cleaning up my list (use AFTER 2-3 follow-ups)
responses.text:
Hi [Name]! [Your name] here.

I'm cleaning up my list and didn't want to remove you without checking.

Still want that cleaning, or should I close it out?

responses.title: Yes or No close (use AFTER 2-3 follow-ups)
responses.text:
Hi [Name]! Just a quick one — are you still interested in that cleaning?

A simple yes or no works 🙂 If yes, I'll send you the next available times.

responses.title: 20% off for booking an estimate
responses.text:
Hi [Name]! Good news — this week we're offering 20% off for anyone who books their free estimate.

I have [day] at [time] open. Want me to lock it in with the discount for you?
